name: Open Playground
starter: # This is free play — there are no tests here.
# Press Run to execute your code, then try changing it.
instructions: This is your open sandbox. Write any Python you like in the editor, then press Run to see what it does in the Output panel.
When you are ready for a challenge, pick an assignment from the list on the left.
Your code runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server. Imports are turned off for these activities.
